[FACT] User is seeking a lease agreement in accordance with the law of Mexico City.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated it cannot create legally binding documents and recommended consulting a specialized lawyer in rental laws in Mexico City.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that templates for lease agreements can be found online but emphasized the importance of ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.  
[USER] User requested a draft of a lease agreement in accordance with the law of Mexico City.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a general example of what a lease agreement might include for a property in Mexico City, titled "CONTRATO DE ARRENDAMIENTO."  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The example lease agreement includes the following sections:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Duration of the contract: Duration specified as ___ (number of months) from the date of signing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Rent: Monthly rent to be paid by the tenant specified as ___ (amount in pesos) due on the ___ day of the month.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Security deposit: Tenant to pay a security deposit of ___ (amount in pesos) at the time of signing, refundable if the property is returned in the same condition.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Use of the property: Property to be used solely as the tenant's residence, not sublet or used for commercial purposes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Maintenance and repairs: Tenant responsible for maintaining the property and must inform the landlord of any damage; landlord responsible for major repairs.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Early termination: Contract may be terminated early by either party with written notice ___ days in advance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Governing law: Contract governed by the laws of Mexico City.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Signatures section for both landlord and tenant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasized that the provided example is just a template and should be adjusted to specific regulations and laws of Mexico City, and advised consulting a specialized lawyer to ensure all clauses are legally sound.
